sources.label: Macropod AUDM Reserve Verification Report as at 1 August 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Macropod issuer self-verification report (prepared under ASIC Corporations (Stablecoin and Wrapped Token Relief) Instrument 2025/867 paragraph 12) as at 1 August 2026 11:59pm: the entire reserve is AUD cash held by Westpac Banking Corporation in the named account 'AUDM Trust Class A Reserve' on behalf of Macropod as trustee for the AUDM Trust, totalling AUD 3,077,657.42 against AUD 3,072,149.75 AUDM on-chain across Ethereum, Redbelly, Solana and Base (excess AUD 5,507.67). The report describes review of statements, transaction records and blockchain addresses; it is a self-attestation, not an independent audit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Macropod issuer self-verification report as at 1 August 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report masks the account number but identifies the single reserve bank and reconciles the complete reserve total to on-chain supply. No lending, investment or rehypothecation is disclosed.
